issues.description: The UML and problem text indicate Farm should have a private list attribute 'animals' with a getter and setter (encapsulation). In the solution, the animals list is declared public (public List<Animal> animals;). This deviates from the UML/description and undermines the intended encapsulation (students may be confused about why a getter/setter is required if the field is public, and it contradicts the UML '-' visibility for the attribute).
issues.suggested_fix: Declare the animals field as private (private List<Animal> animals;) to match the UML and the problem description, keep the public getter and setter, and update any direct field access in code to use the getter/setter. This preserves encapsulation and aligns solution and specification.
